title: senna chrysocarpa
intro: Senna chrysocarpa, commonly known as the golden cassia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Senna chrysocarpa include laxative and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthraquinones and flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin. These bioactive compounds work synergistically to provide relief from gastrointestinal issues and other health concerns.
